messages:
maria.gomez: Quick follow-up from the Dedicated/Private postmortem — summarizing action items for VPC peering, on‑prem constraints, and the isolation bug pattern. Putting owners and target dates here so we can track.

maria.gomez: Action items (short):
1) INF-3421 — VPC peering route consistency check + auto-heal; owner: @sanjay.kumar; target: 2026-04-02; note: add route-table reconciliation job and alert on mismatch.
2) INF-3450 — CI test for peering flaps (integration test simulating transient BGP/peering); owner: @alex.w; target: 2026-04-07; deliverable: test + docs.
3) DOC-190 — On‑prem mount/IO constraints writeup (mount options, MTU, firewall rules) and checklist for Private installs; owner: @elaine.cho; target: 2026-03-30.
4) BUG-8897 — isolation bug root-cause analysis and patch (kernel vs nsproxy handling); owner: @ryan.kelley; target: 2026-04-05; mitigation: temporary policy to reduce blast radius.
5) Monitoring — add recurring query to detect peering flaps pattern (>=2 peering resets in 24h); owner: ops-bot / infra-monitoring; target: 2026-03-28.

sanjay.kumar: taking INF-3421. I already started a spike — found a race in route reconcile when transient peering resets coincide with scale events. Will open INF-3421 branch today. ETA 2026-04-02.

alex.w: INF-3450 sounds good. I'll sketch a failure-plane test that toggles the peer and simulates MTU mismatch. Will post a short PR draft by Fri.

elaine.cho: DOC-190 ack. I'll collate past on‑prem runbooks and include a quick troubleshooting checklist (LSM, MTU, iptables). Will add a Private-install checklist to the console docs.

ryan.kelley: BUG-8897: quick update — root cause looks like a delayed cleanup in the isolation controller causing stale namespace references. I have a repro and a minimal fix; planning patch + e2e for 8897. Target 2026-04-05 but I'll try to move faster.

ops-bot: monitoring alert rule suggested: "peering_flap_rate" -> count(peer_reset events) over 1h. Recommend alert at >=2 resets/hour with severity P2.

maria.gomez: Couple of cross-cutting asks: 1) please add PR links to the respective issues and tag me so I can include in the customer follow-up. 2) add a single line mitigation the support team can run (playbook) for each item.

alex.w: added a short mitigation snippet for test envs in the draft PR: ```# quick mitigation for MTU mismatch
sudo ip link set dev ethX mtu 1500
systemctl restart redwood-net-agent```

sanjay.kumar: for INF-3421 I'll add a playbook step to force route reconciliation and a verification curl to the local health endpoint.

elaine.cho: I'll publish the on‑prem checklist as MD in the docs repo and add a short KB article for customers with dedicated/private installs.

ryan.kelley: I'll include a temporary policy toggle that reduces the number of pods allowed to use the affected isolation path until the patch is rolled out. Will annotate BUG-8897 with the rollback steps.

maria.gomez: Great — please update the tickets as you make progress. I'll compile this thread into the postmortem follow-up tracker and ping the customer with a consolidated timeline after we have PR links.

ops-bot: FYI — flagged past incidents matching this pattern: incidents/1709401123, incidents/1712103456, incidents/1720059810. Suggest we run a 90-day recurrence analysis once INF-3421 is merged.

alex.w: Thanks — will include the simulated flap scenario in the CI so recurrence trends show up earlier.

sanjay.kumar: Quick question for @elaine.cho — for the on‑prem KB, do we want to include a recommended MTU (1500 vs 9000) or just diagnostics?

elaine.cho: Recommend include both: a diagnostic section (how to detect MTU mismatch) and a recommended config table (default 1500, guidance for jumbo frames with notes).

maria.gomez: Final ask — weekly check-in on this thread until all items are closed. I'll post a short status note every Monday. If anyone hits a blocker, drop an update here. :white_check_mark:
